faq: Bandai lists January 30, 2027 for the Japanese release and January 29, 2027 for English. Both official product pages were checked November 16, 2026.
The Japanese product name is エクストラブースター EAST BLUE; Bandai's English name is EXTRA BOOSTER -EAST BLUE-.
How many cards are in EB-06?
67 + 1 card types, 6 cards per pack. Japanese MSRP is ¥240 per pack (tax included) and English MSRP is USD $4.99 per pack.
